The acquired data instead exhibit saturating input response followed by sharp sink-gradient suppression and negative output, consistent with the documented two-layer siphon family with a negative square-root branch. Fit its three parameters numerically to all eight paid rows and allow the required fresh confirmation to decide.

Not relevant to distinguishing candidate mechanisms.
